key_impacts: More than 200 fatalities occurred along Sandy’s track.
About 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
New York City flooding exceeded the 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
Two New Jersey refineries (Port Reading and Bayway in Linden) were shut, removing 26.3% of 1,170,200 BPD capacity.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to power outages.
evidence_snippets: Its arrival on the evening of October 29 generated a massive surge in New York Harbor.
The storm surge caused flooding that exceeded the 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
As of November 6, 2012, refineries in Port Reading and Linden, New Jersey were shut down.
missing_information: Fatalities and some impacts are track-wide and not disaggregated specifically to NYC.
Event duration outside 2012-10-29 for NYC impacts not specified.
